claims.evidence: Photos 0 and 1 show a UPS unit branded Blue Gate.
No battery compartment or battery visible in either photo; seller's statement alone cannot confirm this.
No power-on test, runtime demo, or screen/indicator reading shown; this is a performance claim that requires a live test.
No internal photos or service history shown; casing scuffs do not confirm or deny internal repair work.

risks.proof: Photo of battery compartment open showing battery date/manufacture sticker, or a timed video of unit running on battery only until cutoff
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown/possibly degraded battery, needing replacement

risks.proof: Video showing unit disconnected from mains with a load attached, timestamped, running continuously
risks.if_unproven: priced as base/minimal runtime, not the claimed duration

risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the rating label (usually on side or rear) showing VA/Watt specs
risks.if_unproven: priced at lowest common capacity for this form factor

risks.risk: Unit may not power on or hold any charge
risks.proof: Video of power button pressed, indicator lights activating, and output socket powering a test device
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-functional until shown working

risks.proof: Close-up photo of rear panel sockets

risks.risk: No box/accessories shown, affecting resale value
risks.proof: Photo of original box, manual, or extra cables if present

proof_requests: Video of the UPS powered on, running a connected load, disconnected from mains, timestamped to show actual backup duration
Clear photo of the rating/label sticker showing VA/Wattage
Photo of the battery compartment open, showing battery brand/date
Close-up photo of rear output sockets
Photo of any original box, receipt, or accessories if available
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Blue Gate UPS, so it can be priced at worst case given unverified battery, runtime, and capacity claims, with clear proof points that would raise the price.
